## 0beba7b7e706

Version 2.0.1; SHA256 `13ddd0ff2c71e79f87c7cbca1692e10c89dcf00fe0c99d328b3923e85be7347b`.

**Finding A1 — advertised clip lessons need not clip anything.** Exact call: `generate(0, 0, difficulty="medium", texture="clip")`. The generated 14x13 input is:

```text
0050000000000
0050000000000
5050000000000
0000000200000
0000000000000
0000000000000
0000000000000
0010000000000
0000000000400
0000000000000
0000000000000
0000004000000
0000000000000
0000000000000
```

There are four nonzero prototype cells and four markers, hence nominal stamp mass 16. The actual Racket output sums to 16: **zero nonzero stamp cells are clipped**. All four marker centers are away from the boundary. The exact Racket output is retained in audit_cases.json. Of seeds 0..99 at sample index 0 with these same band/texture settings, **25/100** have zero clipping.

Root cause: generator.py lines 155–156 choose row 3 in the top-edge branch (`add_marker(3, ...)`), not row 0. A centered 3x3 stamp at row 3 does not cross the top boundary. Merely choosing a boundary center would still not guarantee removal of a nonzero prototype cell, because the transformed mask can be sparse. Suggested correction: use a legal boundary marker outside the excluded top-left 3x3 corner and verify actual lost nonzero mass; test all four edge orientations, not just a mode label.

**Finding A2 — the asymmetry gate excludes every canonical prototype.** The generator only accepts prototypes with four distinct identity/CW/left-right/up-down views. The four training prototypes have three distinct views each; the test diagonal has two. The canonical test prototype is:

```text
600
060
006
```

The gate at generator.py line 124 makes every one of these exact mask geometries unreachable, independent of color relabeling. This is a distribution-support limitation, not proof that all generated outputs are wrong. The apparent rationale is visible in INVARIANTS: make transform codes distinguishable. Alternative: mix asymmetric and symmetric prototypes and teach equivalence when transformed masks coincide, rather than excluding it universally.

Scope checked: five canonical input/output pairs and 75 generated cases (five helpful textures x three bands x five seeds) matched the actual Racket rule and the local mirror. The separate 100-seed clipping census used the mirror to calculate mass; its representative zero-clipping case was independently replayed through Racket. No downstream learner shortcut frequency was measured.

triage.reason: Source-bound audit of 0beba7b7e706 clip witness and edb55a59dc46 canonical replay retained in REVIEW/task_indexes; reproduce against current source before target repair. Audited source and approval labels unchanged.

## 0beba7b7e706

Generator SHA256: `13ddd0ff2c71e79f87c7cbca1692e10c89dcf00fe0c99d328b3923e85be7347b`.
Canonical rule SHA256: `4113d165d9437260e261ae77e633d222adeae0ec9fbd08c2eba14f6757863af5`.

**A3 — reproduced clip-texture coverage defect.** For `texture=clip`, 300 draws
(easy/medium/hard, seeds 0..9, indices 0..9): **90/300** lose no nonzero stamp cells
to clipping; **67/300** have no marker on a board edge at all. All 300 pass the
provided validator. An additional 23 have edge markers but no foreground in the
out-of-bounds portion of their sparse stamp. Therefore even an edge-marker count
alone is not a reliable clipping witness.

Concrete reproducer: easy, seed 0, index 0, `texture=clip`, 12x11 board. The nominal
top-edge branch places its marker at row 3 rather than row 0, so the 3x3 stamp is
interior. The reference and an incorrect rival that clamps stamp centers inward
produce the same output. Full actual-Racket evidence:
`checks/audits/0beba7b7e706_clip_texture_without_clipping.json`.
A true clipping contrast is easy, seed 0, index 1: four foreground contributions
fall outside the board and the clamping rival differs from Racket. See
`checks/audits/0beba7b7e706_real_clipping_contrast.json`.

Suggested repair: put a top-edge marker at row 0 outside the excluded top-left
3x3, then require at least one transformed foreground cell genuinely out of
bounds. Also require a lesson-level contrast against clipping rivals. Preserve
legal unclipped cases as ordinary data; do not advertise them as clipping
witnesses. This is a missing training-condition guarantee, not evidence that the
reference counting rule or every generated label is wrong.

**What was checked:** source/canonical examples, explicit clip census, structural
validator, independent transform/count mirror, two Racket-verified contrasting
witnesses and all canonical pairs. Other textures were read but not exhaustively
counterexample-tested; no broad clean bill of health is implied. No source or
authority changes made.

triage.reason: Audit findings retained without changing targets.
